SUMMARY.md: A map of available slots indexed by date, where each date is associated with an array of time slots. If format=range is specified, each slot will be an object with start and end properties denoting start and end of the slot. For seated slots each object will have attendeesCount and bookingUid properties. If no slots are available, the data field will be an empty object {}

Bookings: create, list, load, plus cancel, confirm, decline, reschedule and reassign actions.

By default slot duration is equal to event type length, but if you want to reserve a slot for an event type that has a variable length you can specify it here. If you don't have this set explicitly that event type can have one of many lengths you can omit this.

Cal.com is open-source scheduling infrastructure. Its v2 REST API has 121 operations across 82 URL paths; every call needs a Bearer token, a cal-api-version header whose value differs per resource, and returns its result wrapped in a { status, data } envelope. This SDK hides that plumbing: you work with bookings, event types, schedules, slots, calendars and webhooks as objects with load, list, create, update and remove.
